Open-source toolkit for the Garmin VIRB 360: find and connect to the camera on the local network, control video and photo capture, and browse, download and delete media with FIT telemetry.

**Downloads**

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Android | `V360Lab_*_android_universal.apk` (signed) |
| Windows | `.msi` installer or `-setup.exe` |
| Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu), `.rpm` (Fedora/openSUSE) |

From 0.5.2 on, V360Lab checks for new versions at start-up and updates itself after you confirm (Windows and Linux AppImage install the signed update; Android downloads the APK). The `.sig` files and `latest.json` are used by that automatic update.

The Windows installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. On Android, allow installation from unknown sources for your browser or file manager.

V360Lab is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Garmin. Garmin and VIRB are trademarks of Garmin Ltd. or its subsidiaries.
